narrative.summary: Katherine Quayle, a respected fencing master at a coastal hotel’s fencing academy, is found stabbed in her locked room. The door and main window are locked from inside, and witnesses confirm no one entered or left. Suspicion falls on Hector Gaunt, her rival, but all assume the room was sealed with no access. The mystery hinges on how the killer entered and left a supposedly sealed room, exploiting a hidden coastal corridor exposed at low tide beneath the hotel.

mechanism.description: The killer exploited a natural tidal cave beneath the hotel’s eastern cliffside foundation, accessible only at very low tide. At the unusual low tide on the murder morning, the tidal cave entrance was exposed, allowing entry through a lower window in the victim’s room that was loosely secured and not fully sealed. The door and main window were locked from inside to simulate a sealed room. The tide chart and physical traces confirm this ingress and egress path unseen by hotel occupants.

outcome.result: Killer appeared outside the sealed room to all observers but was inside via the tidal cave natural corridor, exploiting seaside topology and timing to commit murder unseen.

false_assumption.statement: The victim’s room was sealed and inaccessible at the time of murder because the tide was high and all doors and windows were locked from inside.
false_assumption.why_it_seems_reasonable: Witnesses saw no one enter or leave through visible entrances, and the tide was reported high in hotel records, making the tidal cave inaccessible. The door and main window were locked from inside, reinforcing the perception of a sealed room.
false_assumption.what_it_hides: The tide was unusually low at the exact time of the murder, exposing a tidal cave entrance beneath the hotel’s eastern cliffside. The lower window was loosely secured, allowing the killer to enter and leave unseen.

Attempt to enter the victim’s lower window via the tidal cave exposed only at low tide, observing who can physically access and exit unseen, proving the coastal corridor ingress and eliminating all except the culprit from this route.
